name: Moped
description: A device with fully operative pedals, an automatic transmission and a motor producing no more than 2 brake horsepower (1,500 W), with a maximum design speed of 30 mph on level ground. It isn't a motor vehicle, so it needs no title, registration or insurance, but its rider needs an operator's license.

restrictions.rule: Fully operative pedals and an automatic transmission (Nebraska Revised Statutes §60-637)

Its motor produces no more than 2 brake horsepower (1,500 W) and has a maximum design speed of 30 mph on level ground; the definition also caps the motor's cylinder capacity at 50 cc (Nebraska Revised Statutes §60-637)
Not ridden faster than 30 mph (Nebraska Revised Statutes §60-6,313)
Riders need a valid operator's license, but not a Class M motorcycle license (Nebraska Revised Statutes §60-6,310)
Riders and passengers must wear a motorcycle helmet meeting FMVSS 218; the exemption for riders 21 and older applies only to Class M license holders who completed a motorcycle safety course
Riders need eye protection (glasses, goggles or a face shield) or a windshield
Exempt from the title, registration and safety responsibility (insurance) laws (Nebraska Revised Statutes §60-6,309)
Gets full use of a lane on highways posted 45 mph or less; on faster ones it keeps to the right in single file (Nebraska Revised Statutes §60-6,313)
Never on interstate highways or sidewalks (Nebraska Revised Statutes §60-6,313)
Carries a passenger only if designed for one, and its handlebars sit no more than 15 inches above their mount (Nebraska Revised Statutes §60-6,312)
